checklist: gh api sends GH_TOKEN on the wire unchanged (Authorization: token …)
a redirect to another host does not carry Authorization
gh auth login -w with stdin not a tty runs GH_BROWSER by argv and does not pass GH_TOKEN to that child
gh auth login -c treats a failing xclip as clipboard unavailable and still prints the code; a working xclip -in -selection clipboard receives the device code
without the host module, gh api reports that the runtime cannot open a connection

patches.0001-wasip1-slicc-host.patch: gh api and the missing-host case in cert/checklist.mjs and cert/z-missing-host.mjs. The package does not build without this patch (cert/NEGATIVE.md). The wasip1 clipboard command list (pbcopy, then xclip, xsel, wl-copy/wl-paste) is what cert/clipboard.mjs drives.
patches.0002-wasip1-gh-browser.patch: GH_BROWSER argv recording in cert/checklist.mjs, hosts.yml mode 0600 in a 0700 directory, and the clipboard shell-out in cert/clipboard.mjs. Without it, a piped gh auth login -w does not start the browser, and login -c does not run xclip.
